text: DSH Composer Autocomplete（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DeepSeek Harness 的原生对话输入框提供下一句预测和草稿续写。插件在输入框上显示灰字候选，空输入框会在助手回复结束后预测用户可能发送的下一条消息，输入草稿停顿时则生成续写。用户可按 Tab 将候选插入可编辑草稿、按 Alt+方向键切换候选、按 Esc 隐藏建议；采纳不会发送消息。适合希望减少重复输入、继续编写请求的 DSH Web 用户。预测使用会话配置的模型与认证，并将近期对话、工具活动和当前草稿发送给该模型；无需单独配置 API key。

DSH Composer Autocomplete (DSH plugin, Web) suggests follow-ups after replies and draft continuations after pauses. Tab inserts editable text; Alt+Up/Down cycles candidates and Esc dismisses. It uses the session model with conversation, tool activity, and draft text. No separate key is needed.
想让 DSH 在我输入时用灰字补全草稿。
助手回复结束后，能不能提示我下一条可能要发什么？
Suggest a likely follow-up message in my empty DSH composer.
DSH Composer Autocomplete 的功能「草稿续写」：在输入框末尾停顿后请求当前草稿的续写，并将候选以灰字显示；按 Tab 可插入为可继续编辑的文本。
DSH Composer Autocomplete 的功能「下一句预测」：助手一轮回复结束且输入框为空时，基于会话上下文请求后续消息候选；用户可按 Tab 采纳，或用 Alt+方向键切换候选。

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · DeepSeek Harness Composer Autocomplete：**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[](https://github.com/liangzhiyu/dsh-composer-autocomplete/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](LICENSE)

`dsh-composer-autocomplete` adds inline ghost-text completion and next-message suggestions to the native DeepSeek Harness Web composer. **Tab** accepts, **Esc** dismisses, and **Alt+↓ / Alt+↑** cycles candidates. Acceptance inserts an editable draft; it never sends a message.

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · DeepSeek Harness Composer Autocomplete：Licensed under [MIT](LICENSE). By default, predictions use the model configured in your session and consume that service's tokens.

The screenshot shows the actual Harness UI with a deterministic local test model.

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · Install or update：Requirements: Node.js ≥ 24.9 and DeepSeek Harness. Tested with Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` Web. Install the prebuilt package from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/liangzhiyu/dsh-composer-autocomplete/releases/latest):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/liangzhiyu/dsh-composer-autocomplete/releases/download/v0.2.3/dsh-composer-autocomplete-0.2.3.tgz
dsh web
```

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · Install or update：Restart any running Harness instance after installation or updating. For the official desktop app, use its plugin installation UI to select the local package, or use the bundled `dsh` command to manage the desktop profile. The desktop shell has not been tested; this plugin uses the native composer slot on the Web client.

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · Usage：- **Empty composer:** suggests your next message after an assistant turn finishes.
- **Draft completion:** requests a continuation after a typing pause, with the caret at the end. The default pause is 150 ms.
- **Fast mode (default):** one candidate, less context and a shorter output budget. Full mode keeps multiple candidates and the configured context limits.
- **Tab:** accepts the first complete candidate immediately, while later candidates may still be generating. Send the message yourself when ready.
- **Alt+↓ / Alt+↑:** cycles through up to three candidates in Full mode.
- **Esc:** dismisses the current suggestion. Editing the draft allows a new prediction.
- **Settings → General → Composer predictions:** controls the master switch, prediction modes, Fast/Full, and the typing pause (100–5000 ms).

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · Usage：Preferences are stored in the current browser on this device. IME composition keeps ownership of Tab. Predictions pause while the agent is running and stay out of native `/command` and `@reference` menus. Draft edits, session changes, disabling predictions, and hiding the page cancel pending requests. Text insertion goes through Harness's public input actions; a refused insertion never replaces the draft.

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · Usage：The native caret remains visible while suggestions are shown. After acceptance, it stays at the end of the inserted text; click or use the arrow keys to keep editing.

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · Usage：Switching sessions clears suggestions before paint and resets IME and dismissal state. Every candidate belongs to one session, draft, and request, so late responses cannot appear in or be accepted by another view. Result caches are isolated by session ID, session sequence, prediction mode, draft, and Fast/Full setting. Returning to a session can reuse its own valid cache; a new conversation turn invalidates the previous revision.

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · Usage：Typing the exact prefix of an already completed candidate reuses its remaining text locally, with no new model call. Unrelated edits invalidate it. IME composition pauses suggestions and keeps ownership of Tab.

Existing saved typing pauses are preserved. The 150 ms default applies only when no value has been saved. After upgrading, select 150 ms in settings if an older 300 ms preference remains.

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · Latency：Measurements use the same deterministic local test model, timed from the end of typing. Each row is the median of six samples:

| Version / setting | First ghost text | Ready for Tab |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 0.2.2, 300 ms pause | 405 ms | 426 ms |
| 0.2.3 Fast, 150 ms pause | 256 ms | 277 ms |
| 0.2.3 Fast, 100 ms pause | 205 ms | 235 ms |

Matching an existing candidate measured 11 ms to update, with no network request (median of six typed characters).

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · Latency：These measure the local UI/SSE pipeline, not DeepSeek cloud speed or output quality. Actual latency depends on the network, model time to first token, formatting, and generation speed. See [method and raw data](docs/optimization.md). A shorter pause may increase request frequency; choose a longer pause in settings if preferred.

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · Model usage and configuration：Predictions reuse the session's configured model route and host authentication; the plugin stores no separate API key. Recent conversation, tool activity, and the current draft are sent to that model and consume tokens. These auxiliary calls do not appear as conversation messages or in the session's displayed token usage. Configure an available model in Harness before using predictions.

Override host parameters in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · Model usage and configuration：For a slow thinking model, a separately configured fast prediction model can help: set both `provider` and `model` below. This leaves the main conversation model unchanged. Fast mode caps the configured limits at one candidate, 6 messages, 4000 context characters, 2 tool notes and 96 output tokens; Full mode uses the configured limits.

```yaml
- id: composer-autocomplete
  config:
    maxOutputTokens: 220
    timeoutMs: 20000

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · Development and verification：The plugin uses native ESM and a Harness browser module. It has no build step or production npm dependencies.

```sh
node --test test/*.test.mjs
node tools/check-package.mjs
pnpm pack --pack-destination artifacts
```

Browser checks use Playwright against an isolated Harness Web instance with the plugin and local test-model adapter installed:

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · Development and verification：```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
DSH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3087 node tools/browser-smoke.mjs
DSH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3087 node tools/session-switch-smoke.mjs
DSH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3087 node tools/caret-smoke.mjs

The caret check captures the native caret without hiding it. With Pillow installed, verify its actual screenshot pixels with `python3 tools/verify-caret-pixels.py`.

See [verification scope and setup](docs/verification.md) and [changes](CHANGELOG.md).

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-composer-autocomplete
```

Restart the relevant instance. Browser preferences remain; remove the `dsh-composer-autocomplete.*` local-storage keys in developer tools to reset them.

`dsh-composer-autocomplete` 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 聊天输入框增加灰字续写和下一句预测：**Tab** 采纳、**Esc** 关闭、**Alt+↓ / Alt+↑** 切换候选。采纳只写入可编辑草稿，不会发送消息。

采用 [MIT 许可证](LICENSE)。预测默认使用会话已配置的模型，会消耗相应服务的用量。

section: DeepSeek Harness 对话框自动补全

text:
dsh-composer-autocomplete README · 安装：已验证环境：Node.js ≥ 24.9、DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` Web。安装 [GitHub Release](https://github.com/liangzhiyu/dsh-composer-autocomplete/releases/latest) 中的预构建包：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/liangzhiyu/dsh-composer-autocomplete/releases/download/v0.2.3/dsh-composer-autocomplete-0.2.3.tgz
dsh web
```

安装后重启已运行的 Harness。官方桌面端请使用其「插件 → 安装」入口选择本地安装包，或使用该桌面安装附带的 dsh 命令管理 desktop profile。桌面载体未实机验证；Web 侧的代码共用原生输入框插槽。

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · 使用：- 空输入框：一轮回复完成后显示下一句建议。
- 输入草稿：光标停在末尾，默认停顿 150 毫秒后请求续写。
- 快速模式（默认）：只生成一条候选，缩小上下文与输出预算；完整模式保留多候选及配置的上下文上限。
- **Tab**：首条完整候选生成后即可采纳，无需等待其他候选；仍需自己按 Enter 发送。
- **Alt+↓ / Alt+↑**：在完整模式中切换最多三条候选。
- **Esc**：隐藏本次建议；继续输入后可重新预测。
- **设置 → 通用设置 → 输入预测**：总开关、下一句预测、输入续写、快速／完整模式和停顿时间（100–5000 毫秒）分别可调。

设置保存在当前浏览器／设备中。支持中文输入法；拼音组合期间不抢占 Tab。不在 Agent 运行期间预测，不干扰 `/命令` 和 `@引用` 菜单；修改草稿、切换会话、关闭功能会取消旧请求。草稿始终通过 Harness 的插入 API 更新，拒绝插入时保留原文。

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · 使用：页面切到后台时也会取消请求。新版本保留原有的停顿设置；默认 150 ms 只适用于尚未保存设置的浏览器。升级后若仍保存为 300 ms，可在设置中改成 150 ms。

顺着已完成候选的准确前缀继续输入时，直接在本地复用剩余文字，不增加模型调用。输入不同内容会使它失效，输入法组合期间继续暂停提示。

灰字提示显示时保留输入框原生光标；采纳后光标停在插入内容末尾，可以继续输入、用方向键移动或点击其他位置编辑。

切换会话时会在绘制前清空候选，并重置输入法与关闭状态。每条候选绑定所属会话、草稿和请求，旧请求晚到也无法覆盖或被采纳。结果缓存按会话 ID、会话序号、预测模式、草稿及快速／完整设置隔离；切回原会话时可复用其有效缓存，新一轮消息会使旧版本缓存失效。

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · 延迟与优化：在相同的本地测试模型下，从输入停止开始计时，每组 6 次取中位数：

| 版本／设置 | 首次灰字 | 可按 Tab |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 0.2.2，停顿 300 ms | 405 ms | 426 ms |
| 0.2.3 快速模式，停顿 150 ms | 256 ms | 277 ms |
| 0.2.3 快速模式，停顿 100 ms | 205 ms | 235 ms |

匹配已有候选的逐字输入测得约 11 ms 更新提示，无网络请求，取六次输入的中位数。

这是本地确定性模型的 UI／SSE 链路测量，不代表真实 DeepSeek API 的速度或质量。实际延迟还取决于网络、模型首 token 时间、输出格式与生成速度。原始数据及方法见 [优化说明](docs/optimization.md)。更短的停顿也可能增加请求次数，可在设置中调回更长间隔。

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · 模型和用量：预测复用会话的模型路由和宿主认证，不另存 API key。它会把近期对话、近期工具结果和当前草稿发送给已配置的模型，并消耗 token；这类辅助请求不会加入对话记录或计入会话的 token 显示。要运行真实预测，请先在 Harness 中配置可用模型。

可在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖宿主参数：

如果当前主模型思考较慢，可以同时设置下方的 `provider` 和 `model`，让补全单独使用已配置的快速模型，主会话模型不变。快速模式将配置上限进一步限制为一条候选、6 条消息、4000 个上下文字符、2 条工具记录和 96 个输出 token；完整模式使用配置中的上限。

```yaml
- id: composer-autocomplete
  config:
    maxOutputTokens: 220
    timeoutMs: 20000

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · 开发与验证：插件是原生 ESM／Harness 浏览器模块，无需编译或生产依赖。

```sh
node --test test/*.test.mjs
node tools/check-package.mjs
pnpm pack --pack-destination artifacts
```

真实浏览器验证使用 Playwright 驱动 Chromium，在安装了插件的 Harness Web 上检查键盘交互、输入法、设置与草稿行为。运行前安装 Playwright，并提供隔离测试实例地址：

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
DSH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3087 node tools/browser-smoke.mjs
DSH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3087 node tools/session-switch-smoke.mjs
DSH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3087 node tools/caret-smoke.mjs

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · 开发与验证：光标检查会保留截图中的原生光标。安装 Pillow 后，可执行 `python3 tools/verify-caret-pixels.py` 核对光标位置的实际像素。

验证范围和结果见 [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)，版本变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

dsh-composer-autocomplete README · 卸载：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-composer-autocomplete
```

重启对应实例。浏览器设置会保留，可在开发者工具中删除 `dsh-composer-autocomplete.*` 存储键。
